title: Layering screens do not supply a repaired TPU failure law
statement: ROOT compares eight nominal layers,.304mm: equal linear-elastic fully bonded plate rigidity scales512-fold, freely sliding layers8-fold; a simple2mm-radius outer-fibre estimate is7.6%. Actual TPU is large-strain, viscoelastic and history dependent, so this is not measured modulus/fatigue or proof the patch fails. Parent tensile strength is not repaired-film fatigue or weld toughness; pressure/force passes do not identify buried weak bonds. Fold following, release coating, camera localization and tool recovery are actual missing operations. A few grams of prepared spare films challenge inventory/mass claims. Current model cost is15.7% higher per potential work than the strongest exchanger; no30% or threefold whole-system advantage. ROOT stiffness/strain screens are introduced small-strain diagnostics, not a TPU failure prediction.
